title: It Is Important That: Rights for Rivers and Forests

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *es importante que*, *es necesario que* and *es mejor que* from A2 Unit 27: after a value judgment about what someone should do, the verb after *que* is in the present subjunctive. Court rulings about rivers and forests are full of what the State, the communities and the courts should do.

items.spanish: Es importante que los ríos tengan protección legal.
items.english: It is important that rivers have legal protection.

items.spanish: Es necesario que el Estado cumpla las órdenes de la sentencia.
items.english: It is necessary that the State carries out the orders of the ruling.

items.spanish: Es mejor que las comunidades participen en la decisión.
items.english: It is better that the communities take part in the decision.

items.spanish: Es una lástima que algunas sentencias se apliquen despacio.
items.english: It is a pity that some rulings are applied slowly.

sections.content: With a new subject, use *que* and the present subjunctive (*cumpla*, *tengan*). With no new subject, use the infinitive: *Es importante proteger los ríos*.
